import pandas as pd
import torch
from torch import nn, optim
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from snowcast_utils import data_dir, plot_dir, model_dir
import time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Define the model
class SNODASModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SNODASModel, self).__init__()
        self.network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2, 128),  # Increased capacity
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.network(x)

    
def train_model(epochs, model_path, output_csv_path):
    # Load the dataset
    print("Loading dataset...")
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    print(f"Dataset loaded with {df.shape[0]} rows and {df.shape[1]} columns.")

    # Extract features (Latitude, Longitude) and target (snodas)
    print("Extracting features and target variable...")
    X = df[['Longitude', 'Latitude']].values
    y = df['snodas'].values
    print("Features and target extracted.")

    # Normalize the data
    print("Normalizing data...")
    scaler_X = MinMaxScaler()
    scaler_y = MinMaxScaler()
    X = scaler_X.fit_transform(X)
    y = scaler_y.fit_transform(y.reshape(-1, 1)).flatten()
    print("Data normalization complete.")

    # Convert to PyTorch tensors (no train-test split for overfitting)
    print("Converting data to PyTorch tensors...")
    X_tensor = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32)
    y_tensor = torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1)
    print("Data conversion complete.")
    
    # Initialize the model, loss function, and optimizer
    print("Initializing the model, loss function, and optimizer...")
    model = SNODASModel()
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    print("Model initialization complete.")

    # Train the model (overfitting)
    epochs = epochs  # Increased epochs for overfitting
    print(f"Training model for {epochs} epochs...")
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        start_time = time.time()  # Start timing
        model.train()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        predictions = model(X_tensor)
        loss = criterion(predictions, y_tensor)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        end_time = time.time()  # End timing
        epoch_time = end_time - start_time

        if (epoch + 1) % 100 == 0 or epoch == 0:
            print(f"Epoch {epoch + 1}/{epochs}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}, Time: {epoch_time:.4f} seconds")

    print("Training complete.")
    # Save the trained model
    print(f"Saving trained model to '{model_path}'...")
    torch.save(model.state_dict(), model_path)
    print(f"Model saved to '{model_path}'.")

    # Get predictions
    print("Generating predictions...")
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        predictions = model(X_tensor)

    # Reverse scaling to original values
    print("Reversing scaling to original values...")
    predictions_original = scaler_y.inverse_transform(predictions.numpy())
    y_original = scaler_y.inverse_transform(y_tensor.numpy())

    # Save the predictions and true values to a CSV file
    print("Saving predictions and true values to a CSV file...")
    output_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Longitude": scaler_X.inverse_transform(X)[:, 0],
        "Latitude": scaler_X.inverse_transform(X)[:, 1],
        "True SNODAS": y_original.flatten(),
        "Predicted SNODAS": predictions_original.flatten()
    })
    output_df.to_csv(output_csv_path, index=False)

    print("Predictions saved to 'snodas_predictions_overfit.csv'")

def plot_df(df, target_column, output_fig_path):
    # Filter the SNODAS SWE values to be within 0–3000
    df_filtered = df[(df[target_column] >= 0) & (df[target_column] <= 1000)]

    # Plotting SNODAS SWE using latitude and longitude
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
    plt.scatter(
        df_filtered['Longitude'], 
        df_filtered['Latitude'], 
        c=df_filtered[target_column], 
        cmap='viridis', 
        s=10, 
        alpha=0.7
    )
    plt.colorbar(label="SNODAS SWE (0–3000)")
    plt.xlabel("Longitude")
    plt.ylabel("Latitude")
    plt.title("SNODAS SWE by Latitude and Longitude (Filtered: 0–3000)")
    plt.grid(True)
    # plt.show()
    plt.savefig(output_fig_path)
    

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Test
    # Read the CSV file
    epochs = 40000
    date = "2025-01-19"
    file_path = f"{data_dir}/snodas/csv/{date}_snodas_output.csv"  # Replace with the path to your CSV file

    output_csv_path = f"{data_dir}/output/snodas_predictions_{date}_{epochs}.csv"
    # train_model(
    #     epochs=epochs,
    #     model_path=f"{model_dir}/snodas_epochs_20000.pth", 
    #     output_csv_path = output_csv_path
    # )

    output_df = pd.read_csv(output_csv_path)

    plot_df(output_df, "True SNODAS", output_fig_path=f"{plot_dir}/true_snodas_{date}_epochs.png")
    plot_df(output_df, "Predicted SNODAS", output_fig_path=f"{plot_dir}/predicted_snodas_{date}_epochs.png")

import pandas as pd
import torch
from torch import nn, optim
from sklearn.preprocessing import MinMaxScaler
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from snowcast_utils import data_dir, plot_dir, model_dir

# Define the model
class SNODASModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(SNODASModel, self).__init__()
        self.network = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(2, 128),  # Increased capacity
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 128),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(128, 1)
        )
    
    def forward(self, x):
        return self.network(x)

    
def train_model(epochs, model_path, output_csv_path):
    # Load the dataset
    print("Loading dataset...")
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    print(f"Dataset loaded with {df.shape[0]} rows and {df.shape[1]} columns.")

    # Extract features (Latitude, Longitude) and target (snodas)
    print("Extracting features and target variable...")
    X = df[['Longitude', 'Latitude']].values
    y = df['snodas'].values
    print("Features and target extracted.")

    # Normalize the data
    print("Normalizing data...")
    scaler_X = MinMaxScaler()
    scaler_y = MinMaxScaler()
    X = scaler_X.fit_transform(X)
    y = scaler_y.fit_transform(y.reshape(-1, 1)).flatten()
    print("Data normalization complete.")

    # Convert to PyTorch tensors (no train-test split for overfitting)
    print("Converting data to PyTorch tensors...")
    X_tensor = torch.tensor(X, dtype=torch.float32)
    y_tensor = torch.tensor(y, dtype=torch.float32).view(-1, 1)
    print("Data conversion complete.")
    
    # Initialize the model, loss function, and optimizer
    print("Initializing the model, loss function, and optimizer...")
    model = SNODASModel()
    criterion = nn.MSELoss()
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.001)
    print("Model initialization complete.")

    # Train the model (overfitting)
    epochs = epochs  # Increased epochs for overfitting
    print(f"Training model for {epochs} epochs...")
    for epoch in range(epochs):
        start_time = time.time()  # Start timing
        model.train()
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        predictions = model(X_tensor)
        loss = criterion(predictions, y_tensor)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()

        end_time = time.time()  # End timing
        epoch_time = end_time - start_time

        if (epoch + 1) % 100 == 0 or epoch == 0:
            print(f"Epoch {epoch + 1}/{epochs}, Loss: {loss.item():.4f}, Time: {epoch_time:.4f} seconds")

    print("Training complete.")
    # Save the trained model
    print(f"Saving trained model to '{model_path}'...")
    torch.save(model.state_dict(), model_path)
    print(f"Model saved to '{model_path}'.")

    # Get predictions
    print("Generating predictions...")
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        predictions = model(X_tensor)

    # Reverse scaling to original values
    print("Reversing scaling to original values...")
    predictions_original = scaler_y.inverse_transform(predictions.numpy())
    y_original = scaler_y.inverse_transform(y_tensor.numpy())

    # Save the predictions and true values to a CSV file
    print("Saving predictions and true values to a CSV file...")
    output_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Longitude": scaler_X.inverse_transform(X)[:, 0],
        "Latitude": scaler_X.inverse_transform(X)[:, 1],
        "True SNODAS": y_original.flatten(),
        "Predicted SNODAS": predictions_original.flatten()
    })
    output_df.to_csv(output_csv_path, index=False)

    print("Predictions saved to 'snodas_predictions_overfit.csv'")
